fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe vencer al menos 3 meses después del día en que planeas salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area (the expiry date does not need to be within 10 years of the date of issue)

entry.en: On short stays entering the Schengen area, you may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo.
entry.es: En estancias cortas al entrar al espacio Schengen, quizá debas registrar datos biométricos como huellas y una foto.
entry.quote: when you travel into the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo.

entry.en: You must declare cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more.
entry.es: Debes declarar el efectivo o los cheques de viajero por valor de 10.000 euros o más.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 euros or more.

entry.en: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries.
entry.es: No puedes llevar carne, leche ni productos que los contengan a países de la UE.
entry.quote: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries.

entry.en: Non-EEA and Swiss travellers must register their residence within 5 business days of entering the Netherlands.
entry.es: Los viajeros de fuera del EEE y Suiza deben registrar su residencia en un plazo de 5 días hábiles tras entrar en los Países Bajos.
entry.quote: All non-EEA/Swiss travellers must register their residence within 5 business days of entering the Netherlands

safety.en: Pickpocketing and bag-snatching are common, particularly in central Amsterdam and around Amsterdam Central Station.
safety.es: Los carteristas y los tirones de bolso son frecuentes, sobre todo en el centro de Ámsterdam y alrededor de la estación Central.
safety.quote: Pickpocketing and bag-snatching are common, particularly in central Amsterdam and around Amsterdam Central Station.

safety.en: Amsterdam police have warned of criminals posing as police to trick tourists into handing over cash and credit cards.
safety.es: La policía de Ámsterdam advierte de delincuentes que se hacen pasar por policías para que los turistas entreguen efectivo y tarjetas.
safety.quote: Amsterdam police have warned of criminals using false police identities to trick tourists into handing over cash and credit cards.

safety.en: There is a risk of drink spiking, particularly for young women and solo travellers.
safety.es: Existe riesgo de que te echen algo en la bebida, sobre todo a mujeres jóvenes y viajeros solos.
safety.quote: There is a risk of drink spiking, particularly for young women and solo travellers.

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in the Netherlands.
safety.es: Es probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en los Países Bajos.
safety.quote: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in the Netherlands.

safety.en: People drown every year in the canals of Amsterdam and elsewhere in the Netherlands.
safety.es: Cada año hay personas que se ahogan en los canales de Ámsterdam y de otras partes de los Países Bajos.
safety.quote: Every year people drown in the canals of Amsterdam and in canals elsewhere in the Netherlands.

safety.en: Watch out for cyclists, mopeds and trams when crossing roads, especially on zebra crossings.
safety.es: Ten cuidado con ciclistas, ciclomotores y tranvías al cruzar las calles, sobre todo en los pasos de cebra.
safety.quote: Be on the look-out for cyclists, mopeds and trams when crossing roads, especially on zebra crossings.

health.en: To get medically necessary state healthcare in the Netherlands, you need a GHIC or an EHIC.
health.es: Para recibir atención sanitaria estatal médicamente necesaria en los Países Bajos se necesita una tarjeta GHIC o EHIC.
health.quote: To get medically necessary state healthcare in the Netherlands, you need a Global Health Insurance Card (GHIC) or a European Health Insurance Card (EHIC).

health.en: Wikivoyage says the Netherlands has some of the best tap water in the world.
health.es: Wikivoyage indica que los Países Bajos tienen una de las mejores aguas del grifo del mundo.
health.quote: The Netherlands has some of the best tap water in the world.

health.en: Hospitals are mostly in larger cities, and all have English-speaking medical staff.
health.es: Los hospitales están sobre todo en las ciudades grandes y todos tienen personal médico que habla inglés.
health.quote: Hospitals are mostly situated in larger cities, and all have English-speaking medical staff.

health.en: For a non-life-threatening emergency, do not go to the emergency department without referral, as you will be denied access until a GP has seen you.
health.es: En una urgencia no vital no acudas a urgencias sin derivación, pues se te negará el acceso hasta que te vea un médico de cabecera.
health.quote: If you have a non-life-threatening emergency do not go to the emergency department without referral as you will be denied access until a GP has seen you first.

health.en: When walking or camping in forests and dunes, be aware of ticks and tick-carrying diseases.
health.es: Al caminar o acampar en bosques y dunas, ten presentes las garrapatas y las enfermedades que transmiten.
health.quote: When walking or camping in forests and dunes, be aware of ticks and tick-carrying diseases.

health.en: Dial 112 and ask for an ambulance.
health.es: Marca el 112 y pide una ambulancia.
health.quote: Dial 112 and ask for an ambulance.

help.en: The emergency number is 112 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias es el 112 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.
El número de la policía para asuntos no urgentes es el 0900-8844.
help.quote: the telephone number for a non-emergency police presence is 0900–8844.

getting_in.en: Schiphol Airport near Amsterdam is a European hub and, after Heathrow, Charles de Gaulle and Frankfurt, the largest in Europe.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Schiphol, cerca de Ámsterdam, es un centro europeo y, tras Heathrow, Charles de Gaulle y Fráncfort, el mayor de Europa.
getting_in.quote: Schiphol Airport (AMS IATA), near Amsterdam, is a European hub and, after London Heathrow, Paris Charles de Gaulle and Frankfurt Airport, the largest in Europe.

getting_in.en: From Schiphol, Amsterdam, Rotterdam, The Hague, Utrecht and many other cities have a direct train service.
getting_in.es: Desde Schiphol hay tren directo a Ámsterdam, Róterdam, La Haya, Utrecht y muchas otras ciudades.
getting_in.quote: From Schiphol there are excellent railway connections: Amsterdam, Rotterdam, The Hague, Utrecht and many other cities have a direct train service.

getting_in.en: Taxis from the airport are expensive; legal taxis have blue number plates and others should be avoided.
getting_in.es: Los taxis son caros; los legales tienen matrícula azul y conviene evitar los demás.
getting_in.quote: Taxis are expensive: legal taxis have blue number plates, others should be avoided.

getting_in.en: Other international airports are Eindhoven, Maastricht/Aachen, Rotterdam - The Hague and Groningen-Eelde.
getting_in.es: Otros aeropuertos internacionales son Eindhoven, Maastricht/Aquisgrán, Róterdam-La Haya y Groninga-Eelde.
getting_in.quote: Other international airports are Eindhoven Airport, Maastricht/Aachen Airport, Rotterdam - The Hague Airport, and Groningen-Eelde Airport.

getting_in.en: Eurostar direct trains connect Brussels, London, Paris, Antwerp and Lille to Amsterdam and Rotterdam.
getting_in.es: Los trenes directos Eurostar conectan Bruselas, Londres, París, Amberes y Lille con Ámsterdam y Róterdam.
getting_in.quote: Direct trains connect Brussels, London, Paris, Antwerp and Lille to Amsterdam (Centraal and Schiphol Airport) and Rotterdam (Centraal).

getting_around.en: The easiest way to travel is paying with a Mastercard or Visa bank card on the readers, checking in at the start and out at the end.
getting_around.es: La forma más fácil de viajar es pagar con una tarjeta Mastercard o Visa en los lectores, validando al empezar y al terminar.
getting_around.quote: The easiest way to travel around is by using your bank card (Mastercard/Visa) directly on the readers / gates. The working is similar to the older OV-chipkaart system, you check in when you start traveling (single beep), and check out when you stop traveling (double beep).

getting_around.en: There are two main train types: Intercities stop only at major stations and Sprinters stop at all stations.
getting_around.es: Hay dos tipos principales de tren: los Intercity paran solo en estaciones grandes y los Sprinter en todas.
getting_around.quote: There are two main types of trains: Intercities which only stop at major stations and Sprinters which stop at all stations.

getting_around.en: From Schiphol, many tourists meaning to reach Amsterdam Centraal end up at Amsterdam Zuid, so the text says to check the train's destination.
getting_around.es: Desde Schiphol, muchos turistas que quieren ir a Ámsterdam Centraal acaban en Zuid, por lo que el texto aconseja comprobar el destino del tren.
getting_around.quote: These railway stations are not connected directly and many tourists with the idea of going to Amsterdam Centraal wind up at South. Therefore, always check the destination of the train.

getting_around.en: It is uncommon to hail taxis on the street.
getting_around.es: Es poco habitual parar taxis en la calle.
getting_around.quote: It's uncommon to hail taxis on the streets.

getting_around.en: Uber and Bolt operate in the Netherlands.
getting_around.es: Uber y Bolt operan en los Países Bajos.
getting_around.quote: Uber and Bolt operate in the Netherlands

getting_around.en: At unmarked intersections, traffic coming from the right always has priority.
getting_around.es: En las intersecciones sin señalizar, el tráfico que viene por la derecha siempre tiene prioridad.
getting_around.quote: At unmarked intersections, traffic coming from the right always has priority.

money.es: Los Países Bajos usan el euro.
money.quote: Netherlands uses the euro, like several other European countries.

money.en: Mastercard and Visa cards are widely accepted, though some stores block credit cards issued in the EU/EEA.
money.es: Las tarjetas Mastercard y Visa se aceptan ampliamente, aunque algunas tiendas bloquean tarjetas de crédito emitidas en la UE/EEE.
money.quote: Mastercard (including Maestro) and Visa (including V Pay) cards are widely accepted, however some stores choose to block credit cards issued in the EU/EEA to save on card fees.

money.en: An increasing number of stores do not accept cash.
money.es: Cada vez más tiendas no aceptan efectivo.
money.quote: There is an increasing amount of stores that do not accept cash.

money.en: Banknotes of €100 and especially €200 and €500 are very rarely used, and some merchants will not accept them.
money.es: Los billetes de 100 € y sobre todo de 200 y 500 € se usan muy poco y algunos comercios no los aceptan.
money.quote: Banknotes of €100 and especially €200 and €500 are very rarely used, and some merchants will not accept them due to concerns over financial crime.

money.en: Tipping is optional; rounding up to the next euro is acceptable for small bills and 5% to 10% is common for larger ones.
money.es: La propina es opcional; redondear al euro siguiente vale en cuentas pequeñas y un 5% a 10% es habitual en las grandes.
money.quote: In case you do want to tip, rounding up to the next euro is already acceptable for small bills and a 5% to 10% tip is common for larger ones.

money.en: VAT is 21%, with a reduced rate of 9% for groceries, medicine, books, magazines and newspapers.
money.es: El IVA es del 21%, con un tipo reducido del 9% para alimentos, medicinas, libros, revistas y periódicos.
money.quote: VAT is 21%, with a reduced rate of 9% for groceries, medicine, books, magazines and newspapers.

etiquette.en: Visitors are often taken aback by how direct Dutch people are in conversation, but they rarely mean to offend.
etiquette.es: Los visitantes suelen sorprenderse por lo directos que son los neerlandeses al conversar, pero rara vez quieren ofender.
etiquette.quote: Visitors from the Anglosphere are often taken aback by the directness of Dutch people in conversations, but rarely do they intend to offend.

etiquette.en: It is considered vulgar to ask people about their personal wealth or to show how rich you are.
etiquette.es: Se considera vulgar preguntar por la riqueza personal o mostrar lo rico que eres.
etiquette.quote: it is considered vulgar to ask people about their personal wealth or reveal how rich you are.

etiquette.en: Calling the whole country Holland may offend Dutch people from or related to the other provinces.
etiquette.es: Llamar Holanda a todo el país puede ofender a neerlandeses de las otras provincias.
etiquette.quote: that name only refers to the two provinces of North and South Holland, and doing so may offend Dutch people from or related to the other provinces.

etiquette.en: Cheek-kissing is a common greeting among women and between women and men, while two men will generally shake hands.
etiquette.es: El beso en la mejilla es un saludo común entre mujeres y entre mujeres y hombres; dos hombres suelen darse la mano.
etiquette.quote: In the Netherlands, cheek-kissing is a common way of greeting among women and between women and men. Two men will generally shake hands.

etiquette.en: Do not walk on a cycle track, especially when a pavement is available.
etiquette.es: No camines por el carril bici, sobre todo si hay acera disponible.
etiquette.quote: Don't make the mistake of walking on a cycle track, especially when a pavement/sidewalk is available.

etiquette.en: The Netherlands is liberal about homosexuality and is considered one of the most gay-friendly countries in the world.
etiquette.es: Los Países Bajos son liberales con la homosexualidad y se consideran uno de los países más amigables con la comunidad gay.
etiquette.quote: the Netherlands is liberal when it comes to homosexuality and is considered to be one of the most gay-friendly countries in the world.

connectivity.en: The mobile networks are operated by KPN, VodafoneZiggo and Odido; other operators use one of these 3 networks.
connectivity.es: Las redes móviles las operan KPN, VodafoneZiggo y Odido; los demás operadores usan una de estas 3 redes.
connectivity.quote: The cellular phone networks in the Netherlands are operated by KPN, VodafoneZiggo and Odido; other operators use one of these 3 networks.

connectivity.en: 3G networks have been turned off, and 2G is only available at KPN and VodafoneZiggo.
connectivity.es: Las redes 3G se han apagado y el 2G solo está disponible en KPN y VodafoneZiggo.
connectivity.quote: Note that 3G networks have been turned off, and 2G is only available at KPN and VodafoneZiggo, mainly for business purposes.

connectivity.en: Dutch SIM cards with mobile internet are typically available from €10 for 1 GB and a month of validity.
connectivity.es: Las SIM neerlandesas con internet móvil suelen costar desde 10 € por 1 GB y un mes de validez.
connectivity.quote: Dutch sim cards are also available with mobile internet access, typically from €10 for 1 GB and a month validity.

connectivity.en: Users with a mobile account from an EU country can use their data plan in the Netherlands without extra charges.
connectivity.es: Quien tenga una cuenta móvil de un país de la UE puede usar su plan de datos en los Países Bajos sin cargos extra.
connectivity.quote: Users with a mobile phone account from an EU country can use their data plan in the Netherlands without incurring extra charges.
